dossier_meta.statement_text: Let $k\geq 1$. The class of tournaments with twin-width at most $k$ is $\operatorname{\overrightarrow{\chi}}$-bounded.
dossier_meta.context_text: For every integer $k\geq 2$, the tournament $S_k$ has twin-width $1$ and dichromatic number $k$, so tournaments with bounded twin-width can have arbitrarily large dichromatic number. Nevertheless, the authors conjecture that $\operatorname{\overrightarrow{\chi}}$-boundedness holds. Conjecture 3.13 is presented as a sufficient condition implying this conjecture.
